Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women, one seated on a stone throne and one kneeling at her feet.

#2: Footwear: pointed stiletto pumps made of glossy cherry-red PVC, each with a thin tapered six-inch heel, her feet resting naturally.
#2: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy cherry-red PVC with a high polish.
#2: Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#2: Face: her face is wrapped in the glossy PVC hood, only her eyes, nose and lips showing through their openings — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips.

Environment: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with a heavy carved stone throne with high stone arms and a high stone back set against a rough-cut stone block wall, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the stone walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the seated woman and the kneeling woman both completely visible from their feet to the top of their heads, with the stone walls, the vaulted ceiling and the flagstone floor around them at normal human scale. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
